llm_response.reason: The website shows many scam characteristics: 1) It claims to be partnered with Alibaba and to be Asia's largest wholesale platform without offering verifiable company details. 2) Payment is only accepted through cryptocurrencies, which is not normal for general e-commerce and is a common scam method. 3) All legal and contact details are missing or ambiguous ('Copyright 2023 Ltd.' with no valid company), and privacy/return policies exist only as menu options with no substance. 4) The site uses urgency and discount tactics to influence users. 5) The domain is very new (registered May 2025), and ownership details are hidden. 6) No real links or external verification of legitimacy; instead, the site mimics or associates with reputable brands. Together, these factors show this is a high-risk fake online shopping scam.
